m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard! You got my Empyrian Ore back... er... well, most of it. What? Vulcus created Fireblood? Pet Snacks as flux you say?
Of course! Wait. What's with that Egg? Vulcus forged a Raging Bull pet? Then let us thank the coals he won't be creating more!
As for this Egg, I can't care for a Raging Bull here. Will you raise it? Great! Of course, I'll want a full report on it in the future!
Ah, yes! I'm glad you're here. I've just been burned by an Initiate, and I can't think of anyone better suited to help!
A recently expelled Pyromancer named Vulcus IronStrike has absconded with my ultra-rare samples of Empyrian Ore!
It's no ordinary ore, you see. Cryptic legends claims there's an enchantment that transforms smelted Empyrian Ore into 'Fireblood'.
The ancient Empyrian blacksmiths were supposedly then able to cast the liquid-hot Fireblood into living, breathing creatures!
If Vulcus has figured out the Fireblood enchantment, he could use his potent Fire Magic skills to forge unfathomable Fire monsters!
He must be stopped! Go to Vulcus' Forge in Dragonspyre and get that Empyrian Ore back before Vulcus figures out how to forge Fireblood!
Stop that hothead, Vulcus, before he figures out how to enchant the Empyrian Ore into Fireblood and creates horrible monsters!
